terms.gloss: take the bones out of (a fish, meat)
evidence: Ter. Ad. 378: ubi ego vēnerō, exossābitur
terms.comment: From os, bone. The cooks of comedy bone eels: Plautus also has exdorsuāre, to take out the backbone (Aul. 399).

phrases.latin: Congrum istum maximum in aquā sinitō lūdere paulisper: ubi ego vēnerō, exossābitur.
phrases.english: Let that biggest conger play in the water a little while: when I come back, it shall be boned.
